title: Quasi-affine covering by saturations of affine opens
statement: Let $p:A\to B$ be a flat [def-weil-flat-morphism], surjective [def-weil-surjective-morphism] morphism of finite presentation between affine schemes [def-pc-scheme]; finite presentation means locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $\pi:V\to A$ be a scheme over $A$ with a descent datum $\phi:V\times_B A\xrightarrow{\sim}A\times_B V$ satisfying the cocycle $\phi_{02}=\phi_{12}\circ\phi_{01}$ [def-pd-descent-datum, def-pc-fibre-product]. For an affine open subscheme $C\subset V$ [def-weil-open-immersion], define $r_C:C\times_B A\to V$ as the inclusion into $V\times_B A$, followed by $\phi$ and the projection to $V$, and put $W_C=\operatorname{im}(|r_C|)\subset |V|$. Assume $\pi$ is separated [def-weil-proper-morphism] and locally quasi-finite [pqf-def-quasifinite]. Then $W_C$ is open and quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme], $C\subseteq W_C$, and the induced morphism from the open subscheme $W_C$ to $A$ is quasi-affine [def-nagata-quasi-affine-morphism]. As $C$ ranges through all affine opens of $V$, these $W_C$ form an open covering of $V$. No quasi-compactness or local finite-presentation hypothesis on $\pi$ is imposed. All schemes and families lie in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention].

proof.text: Use the transport cocycle and transport_self of [def-pd-descent-datum] to construct the involution i of R = V ×_B A with i followed by pr_V equal to D.toHom. The universal transport formula proves that i followed by D.toHom is pr_V; the two pullback projections then show i² = 1. Thus D.toHom is the composite of an isomorphism and pr_V, which is open by [lem-weil-pbc-flat-lfp-open]. The inclusion C ×_B A → R is an open immersion by [lem-weil-pbc-open-immersion-base-change], so the range of its composite with D.toHom is open.

The affine scheme $C$ is quasi-compact by [lem-weil-pbc-affine-scheme-qcqs]. Since $p$ is quasi-compact, its base change $C\times_BA\to C$ is quasi-compact by [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-morphism-permanence](3), and its source is quasi-compact by (2) of that node. The continuous image $W_C$ is quasi-compact: pull an open covering of $W_C$ back along the surjection $|C\times_BA|\to W_C$, take a finite subcover, and use surjectivity to obtain a finite subcover of $W_C$. This proves quasi-compactness as a space, without any quasi-compactness hypothesis on $V$.

The diagonal lift C → C ×_B A sends a point to itself and its structural A-point. Its composite with the pullback inclusion is the lift of (C.ι, C.ι ≫ π) into V ×_B A. The universal transport formula of [def-pd-descent-datum], followed by transport_self, identifies its composite with D.toHom with C.ι. Evaluating this equality on points proves C ⊆ W_C. All maps are the canonical maps of [def-pc-fibre-product].

The open immersion W_C.ι is separated by [def-weil-open-immersion], [def-weil-closed-immersion] and [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Since π is separated, Mathlib’s composition instance gives separatedness of W_C.ι ≫ π (equivalently, the closed diagonal restricts to the open subscheme).

Apply Scheme.Hom.isLocallyQuasiFinite_iff from WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.QuasiFiniteMorphismComparison to the Stacks-sense hypothesis [pqf-def-quasifinite]. This gives Mathlib local quasi-finiteness and local finite type, using [lem-weil-pbc-lqf-locally-finite-type]. Both are preserved by composition with the open immersion W_C.ι. Step 2 supplies CompactSpace W_C; the affine target A is quasi-separated by [lem-weil-pbc-affine-scheme-qcqs], so [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-morphism-permanence] gives quasi-compactness of W_C → A. Apply [lemma-nagata-quasi-affine-morphism-of-quasi-finite] to this morphism.

The affine-open basis [lem-weil-pbc-affine-opens-basis] gives iSup_affineOpens_eq_top. By step 3 each affine open is contained in its saturation, so monotonicity of the supremum proves that the W_C have supremum top. This argument includes the empty scheme.

lean.statement: theorem affine_descent_saturation_quasi_affine_cover {A B : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine A] [IsAffine B] (p : A ⟶ B) [Flat p] [Surjective p] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation p] [QuasiCompact p] [QuasiSeparated p] {V : Over A} (D : Over.DescentDatum p V) [IsSeparated V.hom] (_hπ : V.hom.IsLocallyQuasiFinite) : ∃ W : V.left.affineOpens → V.left.Opens, (∀ C : V.left.affineOpens, (W C : Set V.left) = Set.range (pullback.map (C.1.ι ≫ V.hom ≫ p) p (V.hom ≫ p) p C.1.ι (𝟙 A) (𝟙 B) (by simp) (by simp) ≫ D.toHom) ∧ IsCompact (W C : Set V.left) ∧ C.1 ≤ W C ∧ IsQuasiAffineHom ((W C).ι ≫ V.hom)) ∧ (⨆ C : V.left.affineOpens, W C) = ⊤

reviewed_lean.note: Statement matches the node and Stacks 02W8 clause by clause. Only the lean record differs from the live node; lean.statement appears verbatim in the module. r_C = pullback.map(C.ι,𝟙,𝟙) ≫ D.toHom, with toHom = pr_V∘φ (orientation checked in DescentDatum.lean:127); W C is pinned by equality to Set.range of r_C, so not hollow. Hypotheses: p Flat/Surjective/LFP/QC/QS on affines; π IsSeparated plus the Stacks IsLocallyQuasiFinite (includes finite type); nothing extra on π. Conclusions: Opens, IsCompact, C ≤ W C, IsQuasiAffineHom ((W C).ι ≫ V.hom), ⨆ = ⊤. Same expression and hypotheses as the sibling lem-trf-descent-saturation-invariant-open module. Edge cases checked: empty V, empty C, identity p, non-qc V, empty B. No duplicate found. Docstrings carry the source place and blueprint tag; the proof is sorry only; the report has both sections. Advisories: IsCompact vs the recorded CompactSpace (equivalent); three proof-only plain imports. No compile, since nothing was changed.
